$comment: Spark variant: Grok-4.3 manager + max-everything Claude/Codex worker pool.
This is the default for `--adapter spark_full` when no --config is passed.
Cost rationale: workers (Claude Code + Codex CLI) are subscription-flat;
Spark's manager goes through OpenRouter at pay-per-token. Grok-4.3 is the
cheapest credible manager among the four candidates and the variant we
expect to one-shot the most tasks for the lowest variable cost.
Effort: 'max' is the provider-native string we pass through to OpenRouter.
If the model doesn't honor it, OpenRouter typically clamps or ignores.
